visitedThisRun.title: 4-1大稻埕地方產業與故事旅遊(水瓶子).pdf
notes: 2012 material treats guided-tour practice as a repeatable field cycle: planning, archival lookup, site reconnaissance, route design, public communication, on-site execution and documentation.
It repeatedly uses existing buildings, objects, streets and local stories as anchors for interpretation, and includes examples of linking scattered historical sites into walking routes.
Keep only as a candidate layer around field interpretation, route-making, local narrative and reuse of existing urban objects. No comparison or synthesis attempted.

visitedThisRun.title: 企劃書2019.10.30.docx
notes: 2019 Quanzhou/New Bridge community proposal defines the neighborhood as a living city museum and residents as living oral-history carriers rather than treating heritage as only fixed monuments.

The draft organizes intervention through linked nodes, walking routes, resident participation, everyday services, oral-history collection, small classes and a 'living story museum' where local elders tell stories in place.
Keep as a candidate layer around living museum, resident memory, node-and-route organization, community participation and everyday-use heritage. No theory unification or use judgment attempted.
